svg.title: Self-Correcting Ledger Agent: 3-tier architecture
svg.text: 3-tier reference architecture · evidence-grounded invoice reconciliation · runs fully offline by default
Agent replay of every graph step
Checks %PDF magic bytes and MAX_UPLOAD_MB, returns typed errors
ThreadPool(2) runs run_job -> run_invoice · single-instance lock
Guards: max revisions · no-progress signature · evidence confidence
One server process per data dir
Fails fast if a second starts
Browser uploads a PDF, then polls job state
Worker thread runs run_invoice on the LangGraph core
Job record and upload written; trace events stored
